name: qfd_dv_s5_redb-s5redb-COMMIT

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_dv_s5_red u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_S5_RED_RING --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_dv/s5/qfd_dv_s5_leaves.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu_q.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_vreduce.sv rtl/qwen_dv/s5/qfd_dv_s5_vreduce_rb.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: s5_mut_red_ring
bench.cmd: export PATH=$HOME/.local/opentallas-tools/verilator-5.050/bin:$PATH && S5_DEFS=+define+OT_S5_RED_RING bash rtl/test/qwen_dv/s5/run_s5.sh {RUN}/m eq red

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_dv_s5_redb --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_dv_s5_red  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
